title: Triggers
description: Webhook triggers start a process when another system calls a URL, e.g. a Gatus alert starts a diagnosis runbook. Each trigger has its own secret; runs use the rights of the trigger's owner and are skipped and logged if the owner loses access.
rotateConfirm: Rotate the secret of "{{name}}"? The current secret stops working immediately – update the caller (e.g. Gatus) right away.
deleteConfirm: Delete webhook trigger "{{name}}"? Calls to its URL will be answered with 404.

form.name: Name
form.inputsHint: One JSONata expression per input, evaluated against <c>body</c> (the JSON payload), <c>headers</c> (allow-listed headers only) and <c>query</c> (URL parameters). Strings need quotes, e.g. <c>{{example}}</c>. Inputs without an expression use their default.
form.sampleHint: Pre-filled with a Gatus custom alert as configured in docs/GATUS.md
form.authHint: Static token: <bearer/> or <token/> (what Gatus can send). HMAC: <sig/> (GitHub-style; the secret never travels).
form.sigHeader: X-Steward-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>
form.cidrsHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges (IPv4/IPv6), e.g. 10.20.0.0/16. Empty: any address. Behind a reverse proxy, the proxy's address is seen.
form.headersHint: Lower-case names, e.g. x-gatus-instance. Credential headers can never be mapped.
form.dedupeHint: 0 = off. Gatus re-sends the same alert as a reminder.
form.skipIfRunning: Skip while the previous run is still running or waiting
form.rightsOf: Runs execute with the rights of {{owner}}. The secret is shown once after saving; it is stored encrypted and can be rotated at any time.
form.rightsOfYou: Runs execute with your rights (you are the owner). The secret is shown once after saving; it is stored encrypted and can be rotated at any time.

secret.title: Secret of "{{name}}"
secret.copyNowText: It is shown only once and cannot be recovered. Store it in the calling system's secret store (for Gatus: an environment variable such as <c>{{name}}</c>). If it is lost or leaked, rotate it.
secret.hostsHint: The host name of the URL must be listed in {{name}} when Gatus runs on another machine. More in Gatus custom alerts and {{doc}}.

test.title: Test call – {{name}}
test.intro: Sends the payload through the real endpoint (secret, content type, rate limit, de-duplication and input mapping are checked as for any caller; the source address check is skipped). The call and the run are marked as a test.

history.title: Recent calls – {{name}}
history.intro: Accepted calls (run started, skipped or failed). Rejected calls – wrong secret, address, rate limit, duplicates – are only counted and recorded in the audit log.
history.introCount_one: Accepted calls (run started, skipped or failed). Rejected calls – wrong secret, address, rate limit, duplicates – are only counted ({{count}} so far) and recorded in the audit log.
history.introCount_other: Accepted calls (run started, skipped or failed). Rejected calls – wrong secret, address, rate limit, duplicates – are only counted ({{count}} so far) and recorded in the audit log.

emptyState.title: No webhook triggers yet
emptyState.text: Let another system start a process by calling a URL, e.g. a Gatus alert that starts a diagnosis runbook. Each trigger gets its own secret.
